newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady to firm, fuel lacks buyers.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firm, fuel lacks buyers.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firm on Wednesday morning, lighter products gaining from the strength of futures, while fuel oil barges lacked buyers.

Heating oil barges were almost $1 a tonne higher as IPE gas oil futures rose. Offers for prompt held at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam. Buyers remained scarce. Low Rhine levels also restricted movement into Germany.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were still offered at $85 by at least five players, but very few buyers came forward. Apart from one larger enquiry, bunker demand appeared poor.
